en.title: BestFPS
en.shortDescription: Led and coordinated a university team developing a first-person shooter in Unity and C#. Managed tasks and workflow while maintaining an Agile-inspired development process with tickets, reviews, and controlled merges. Focused on clean OOP structure and team organization, gaining valuable experience in collaborative software development and project coordination.

items.text: Led a university team project to develop a first-person shooter in Unity and C#. While contributing to the development, I primarily acted as the team’s coordinator, organizing tasks, keeping the team aligned, and overseeing the overall workflow. We followed an Agile-inspired development process using tickets, structured reviews before merging into the main branch, and clear project organization. The project also emphasized object-oriented programming and separation of responsibilities. The experience strengthened my skills in team coordination, collaborative development, Git-based workflows, and project organization.
I led the team and implemented the core shooting and movement systems.

hu.title: BestFPS
hu.shortDescription: Egy csapatban készített first-person shooter projekt.

items.text: A BestFPS egy csapatprojekt volt, amely a multiplayer hálózatiságot és a játékérzetet vizsgálta.
Vezettem a csapatot és megvalósítottam a lövési és mozgási alaprendszereket.
